ucs.title: [LLM] Akira BYOVD chain: rwdrv.sys + hlpdrv.sys service registration to blind EDR before encryption
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Akira/PUNK SPIDER/Howling Scorpius BYOVD pair documented in CISA #StopRansomware AA24-109A — loading ThrottleStop's vulnerable rwdrv.sys to gain ring-0, then registering Akira's helper driver hlpdrv.sys to kill EDR/AV processes before deploying the locker. The driver names + sc.exe service-registration verbs are an Akira fingerprint, not a generic ransomware tell.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="sc.exe" AND (Processes.process="*rwdrv*" OR Processes.process="*hlpdrv*") AND (Processes.process="*create*" OR Processes.process="*kernel*" OR Processes.process="*binPath*" OR Processes.process="*start*") by host Processes.dest Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path values(Filesystem.process_name) as writer from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="rwdrv.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="hlpdrv.sys") by host Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) ] | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let AkiraDrivers = dynamic(["rwdrv.sys", "hlpdrv.sys"]);
let ServiceReg = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "sc.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("rwdrv", "hlpdrv")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("create", "start", "kernel", "binPath")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"  // exclude machine accounts
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Signal = "sc.exe Akira BYOVD service registration",
              Evidence = ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFolderPath, ReportId;
let FileDrop = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ (AkiraDrivers)
    | where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Windows\System32\drivers\" and InitiatingProcessFolderPath startswith @"C:\Windows\")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              Signal = strcat("Akira BYOVD driver file drop: ", FileName),
              Evidence = FolderPath,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFolderPath, ReportId;
union ServiceReg, FileDrop
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let AkiraDriverTokens = dynamic(["rwdrv", "hlpdrv"]);
let ServiceReg = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\sc.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any (AkiraDriverTokens)
    | where CommandLine has_any ("create", "start", "kernel", "binPath")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName,
              CommandLine, ParentProcessName,
              Signal = "sc.exe Akira BYOVD service registration";
let AsimDrop = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where TargetFileName in~ ("rwdrv.sys", "hlpdrv.sys")
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer = DvcHostname,
              SubjectUserName = ActorUsername,
              NewProcessName = ActingProcessName,
              CommandLine = ActingProcessCommandLine,
              ParentProcessName = ActingProcessName,
              Signal = strcat("Akira BYOVD driver file drop: ", TargetFileName);
union ServiceReg, AsimDrop
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Akira BYOVD Driver Service Registration (rwdrv.sys / hlpdrv.sys)
id: 9a5f3c7e-2c41-4f7d-9d4b-1a9b3a2b1c11
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects sc.exe registering a kernel service for ThrottleStop's vulnerable
  rwdrv.sys or Akira's helper hlpdrv.sys driver - the documented Akira /
  PUNK SPIDER / Howling Scorpius BYOVD chain used to disable EDR/AV
  immediately before encryption (CISA AA24-109A).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-109a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\sc.exe'
  selection_driver:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'rwdrv'
      - 'hlpdrv'
  selection_verb:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'create'
      - 'kernel'
      - 'binPath'
      - ' start '
  condition: selection_img and selection_driver and selection_verb
falsepositives:
  - Highly unlikely on enterprise endpoints; ThrottleStop is a consumer overclocking tool and hlpdrv.sys has no legitimate distribution.
level: high
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1543.003
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\sc.exe OR *\\SC.exe OR *\\SC.EXE) (@CommandLine:*rwdrv* OR @CommandLine:*RWDRV* OR @CommandLine:*hlpdrv* OR @CommandLine:*HLPDRV*) (@CommandLine:*create* OR @CommandLine:*kernel* OR @CommandLine:*binPath* OR @CommandLine:*start*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\sc\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(rwdrv|hlpdrv)", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)(create|kernel|binpath|\\sstart\\s)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: rwdrv.sys + hlpdrv.sys is a publicly attributed Akira fingerprint from CISA AA24-109A and Sophos/SentinelOne incident reports. Other BYOVD ransomware crews (BlackCat used gmer64.sys, LockBit used wnbios.sys, RansomHub used a renamed Avast aswArPot.sys) cluster around different driver pairs - rwdrv+hlpdrv co-occurrence is specifically Akira. The sc.exe service-registration verb plus the driver toke

ucs.title: [LLM] Akira pre-encryption exfiltration: rclone copy/sync to MEGA cloud storage
ucs.description: Hunts Akira / GOLD SAHARA's documented double-extortion exfil channel — rclone.exe copying/syncing staged data to a MEGA remote (mega:, mega.nz, mega.io) prior to dropping the .akira locker. CISA AA24-109A, Sophos X-Ops and Arctic Wolf intrusion writeups all call out the rclone→MEGA pairing as Akira's preferred path; combining the binary, verb and destination keeps this tight to Akira vs generic rclone admin use.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.process="*rclone copy*" OR Processes.process="*rclone sync*" OR Processes.process="*rclone move*") AND (Processes.process="*mega:*" OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*" OR Processes.process="*mega.io*" OR Processes.process="*--config*" OR Processes.process="*remote:*") by host Processes.dest Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Network_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_host="*mega.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*mega.io" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*mega.co.nz") AND All_Traffic.app!="chrome" AND All_Traffic.app!="msedge" AND All_Traffic.app!="firefox" by host All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest_host All_Traffic.app All_Traffic.bytes_out | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | where bytes_out > 10000000 ] | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 72h;
let MegaHosts = dynamic(["mega.io", "mega.nz", "mega.co.nz", "g.api.mega.co.nz", "userstorage.mega.co.nz"]);
let BrowserBins = dynamic(["msedge.exe", "chrome.exe", "firefox.exe", "iexplore.exe", "brave.exe", "opera.exe"]);
let RcloneToMega = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName =~ "rclone.exe"
       or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("rclone copy", "rclone sync", "rclone move")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega:", "mega.nz", "mega.io", "remote:")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Signal = "rclone -> MEGA (Akira exfil pattern)",
              FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256, ReportId;
let DirectMegaUpload = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (MegaHosts)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserBins)
    | summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
                ConnCount = count(), DistinctHosts = dcount(RemoteUrl),
                SampleUrl = any(RemoteUrl)
              by DeviceName,
                 AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
                 InitiatingProcessFileName,
                 InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
                 InitiatingProcessFolderPath
    | extend Signal = "Non-browser process -> MEGA cloud (Akira exfil pattern)"
    | project Timestamp = FirstSeen, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Signal, FileName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              FolderPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ProcessCommandLine = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              SampleUrl, ConnCount;
union isfuzzy=true RcloneToMega, DirectMegaUpload
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 72h;
let MegaTokens = dynamic(["mega:", "mega.nz", "mega.io", "remote:"]);
let RcloneToMega = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\rclone.exe"
       or CommandLine has_any ("rclone copy", "rclone sync", "rclone move")
    | where CommandLine has_any (MegaTokens)
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName,
              Signal = "rclone -> MEGA (Akira exfil pattern)";
let AsimRclone = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where TargetProcessName endswith "rclone.exe"
       or ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("rclone copy", "rclone sync", "rclone move")
       or TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("rclone copy", "rclone sync", "rclone move")
    | where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (MegaTokens)
         or ActingProcessCommandLine has_any (MegaTokens)
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer = DvcHostname,
              SubjectUserName = ActorUsername,
              NewProcessName = TargetProcessName,
              CommandLine = TargetProcessCommandLine,
              ParentProcessName = ActingProcessName,
              Signal = "rclone -> MEGA (ASIM)";
union RcloneToMega, AsimRclone
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Akira Exfiltration via Rclone to MEGA Cloud Storage
id: 7b1c8e44-5d12-4a9a-b4e6-23a1c0d1f2e2
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects rclone.exe being used to copy/sync/move data to a MEGA remote -
  Akira / GOLD SAHARA / Howling Scorpius's documented double-extortion exfil
  channel ahead of .akira encryption (CISA AA24-109A; Sophos / Arctic Wolf IR
  reports).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-109a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/17
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_rclone_img:
    Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
  selection_rclone_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'rclone copy'
      - 'rclone sync'
      - 'rclone move'
  selection_mega_dest:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'mega:'
      - 'mega.nz'
      - 'mega.io'
      - 'remote:'
  condition: (selection_rclone_img or selection_rclone_cmd) and selection_mega_dest
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned IT backup automation using Rclone with a MEGA remote (rare in enterprise; allowlist by host/user if so).
level: high
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.t1071.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\rclone.exe OR *\\RClone.exe OR *\\RCLONE.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*"rclone copy"* OR *"rclone sync"* OR *"rclone move"* OR *"RClone Copy"*)) (@CommandLine:*mega\:* OR @CommandLine:*mega.nz* OR @CommandLine:*mega.io* OR @CommandLine:*MEGA.nz* OR @CommandLine:*MEGA.io* OR @CommandLine:*remote\:*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\rclone\.exe$/i OR regex("(?i)rclone\\s+(copy|sync|move)", field=CommandLine))
| regex("(?i)(mega:|mega\\.nz|mega\\.io|remote:)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT regex("(?i)\\\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|iexplore|brave)\\.exe$", field=ParentBaseFileName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: Other ransomware crews exfiltrate too, but the rclone+MEGA pairing specifically maps to Akira/Conti-lineage tradecraft - LockBit favored StealBit/MegaSync, BlackCat used ExMatter, Cl0p staged via WinSCP+sftp. Combining the rclone process token with mega: / mega.nz / remote: in the same command line filters out admin Rclone use (which typically targets self-hosted S3/B2/SFTP remotes) and lands on A
